_title: DRAFT crosswalk v2 — for review (not yet wired into the app)
_approach: Per the data product owner: DO NOT hand-map names. Use the RM Lookups to standardize both sides and JOIN. Rates come from the Benchmarking (BEM) tables (pre-processed, SKU-based); volume from the TOS moves view. Remaining work is attribute (SKU) mapping — done by Claude.

data_sources.tos_volume: "APMT-BEATS"."Global"."insights_and_visualizations"."Vessel Moves Insights - Power BI"."GBL_moves_simulator"  (has a ready-made `key` column, e.g. 'Full-Discharge-20')
data_sources.activity_catalogue: Confirm the load/discharge quay activities against the global activity catalogue; the working set is under quay_move_activities below.

join_keys.sku: map TOS.key attributes (freight/direction/length + category) to BEM.SKU attributes (activity_name, Freight_Type, Direction, Container_Length) — see sku_mapping.

Vado2.issue: Terminal_mapping maps 'Vado2' -> 'Vado2' (unmapped), but pricing 'Vado Ligure' -> 'Vado Gateway Terminal (APM Terminals)'. Join fails without an override.
Vado2.action: Use this override in the tool; also ask the DPO to add 'Vado2' as an alias in Terminal_mapping.
Vado2.reefer_note: 'Vado Reefer' (standard 'Reefer Terminal Vado') holds reefer-specific sheets — optional overlay for reefer rates.

operator_bridge.note: Replaces the earlier hand-built name-pattern map. TOS operator codes equal the Standard_Operator_Code; BEM.Customer maps to the same via Customer_mapping.

examples.HMM: HMM Co. Ltd / HMM HQ / 'HMM' -> code HMM
examples.MAE: Maersk Line / Maersk Line HQ / A.P. Moller - Maersk A/S / 'MAE' -> code MAE

operator_bridge.unmapped_codes: Junk TOS codes (DUMMY/TEST/UNK/IMO-numbers) and codes with no rate sheet -> no current rate; fall back to a pricing-Customer picker / upload / manual.

quay_move_activities._comment: Load/Discharge move family to include (confirm vs global catalogue). Restow/Transshipment carry the 1-move-vs-2-move caveat below.
include: Load or Discharge Move excl Yard Move
Load or Discharge Move - Premium Service
Load or Discharge Move - Bundled Platform or Flat rack
Restow Move - Via Quay - Premium Service
Restow Move - Cell to Cell - Premium Service
exclude_ancillary: Hatch Cover Move - Cell to Cell

sku_mapping._comment: TOS.key -> BEM.SKU attribute mapping (Claude task #3). BEM.SKU = activity_name_ContainerLength_Direction_FreightType_ContainerType.
sku_mapping.length_handling: APPROVED: include ONLY 20/40/45 ft. Any other length (24, blank, etc.) is EXCLUDED from the simulation.

category_to_activity.gateway (Full/Empty-Load/Discharge): Load or Discharge Move (fallback Gateway Cycle Move / Load Move / Discharge Move)

sku_mapping.rate_fallback: Use the length/freight/direction-specific SKU when present; else fall back to the activity's blended SKU (Container_Length/Freight_Type='Any'). Current sheets are often blended ('Any').

one_move_vs_cycle_caveat._from_reviewer: BEM rate is per SINGLE move (half cycle). TOS volume is also per single move. So revenue = BEM_rate x TOS_moves directly (NO divide-by-2 by default). However, in the underlying pricing some rates are quoted per single move and some per 2 moves (full cycle).
one_move_vs_cycle_caveat.rule: DEFAULT: rate basis = per single move -> revenue = rate x moves. Expose a per-activity 'rate basis' toggle; if an activity's pricing is per cycle (2 moves), convert to per-move (rate / 2) before multiplying by moves. Applies mainly to Transshipment/Restow.

rate_sheet_selection.effective: Keep rows where EffectiveStartDate <= today <= EffectiveEndDate (exclude EXPIRED/DRAFT).
hq_vs_local_tiebreak: 1) If both an HQ and a local-entity sheet are effective, choose the one with the LATEST contract start date.
2) If start date AND end date are identical (still tied), ASK THE USER to choose which rate sheet to pull — and allow them to upload an Excel/CSV rate sheet instead.
3) RateSheetName encodes entity + dates (e.g. 'Hapag-Lloyd HQ-Lazaro-01/06/2024-31/01/2025-...') to support this.

resolved_decisions: [APPROVED] Vado2 -> 'Vado Gateway Terminal (APM Terminals)' override (also flag to DPO to add the alias).
[APPROVED] Length handling: include ONLY 20/40/45 ft; exclude all other lengths.
[APPROVED] Activities: use BEM quay activity_name values directly (the quay_move_activities include list); NO global-catalogue comparison.
[APPROVED] Rate basis: BEM = per single move; TOS = per single move; revenue = rate x moves (no /2). Per-activity 'per cycle' toggle halves the rate when needed.
[CONFIRMED] Sources: Stage 0 volume = GBL_moves_simulator (TOS); Stage 3 pricing = BEM_Pricing_Base.
